callGraph.callee:
withTimeout(
      lspClientManager.getOrCreateClient(language),
      LSP_TIMEOUT,
      null as typeof lspClient
    )
      .then

withTimeout(
        runEslintOnContent(content, filePath),
        LSP_TIMEOUT,
        [] as Awaited<ReturnType<typeof runEslintOnContent>>
      )
        .then
